name: gizza-ai/release-from-commits
summary: Compute the next semver and release notes from Conventional Commits

tool.description: Given the current semantic version and a pasted Conventional Commits log, compute the next version and grouped release notes. Supports type(scope)! headers, BREAKING CHANGE footers, configurable minor and patch type lists, pre-1.0 cautious mode, prerelease finalize/increment/ignore policies, hidden changelog types, optional repository links, optional release dates, and markdown/version/json output formats. It does not read git itself; paste the relevant log range.

commits.description: Pasted Conventional Commits log to analyse. Accepts git log --oneline lines, full commit messages, or bullet lists. Supports type(scope)!: subject plus BREAKING CHANGE footers.

current_version.description: Current semantic version or tag prefix plus version, such as 1.4.2, v1.4.2, or web-v0.8.0. The same prefix is preserved on the next version.

hidden_types.description: Comma-separated commit types omitted from markdown release notes (breaking changes still appear). Use an empty string to show every type. Default chore,style,ci,build,test.

minor_types.description: Comma-separated commit types that trigger a minor bump. Default feat,feature.

output_format.description: Output format: markdown release notes (default), version for CI scripts, or json for structured downstream use.

patch_types.description: Comma-separated commit types that trigger a patch bump. Use * to make every non-breaking commit at least a patch. Default fix,perf,revert.

prerelease_identifier.description: Identifier used when prerelease_policy=increment starts a new prerelease, for example rc, beta, or alpha. Default rc.

prerelease_policy.description: How to handle an existing pre-release version: finalize removes the suffix when the bump matches, increment stays on a prerelease line, ignore drops prerelease metadata before bumping. Default finalize.

release_date.description: Optional release date shown in the markdown heading, for example 2026-08-29.

repo_url.description: Optional repository URL such as https://github.com/acme/widget. When set, commit hashes and #123 issue references become links and a compare link is added.

zero_version_policy.description: How 0.x versions handle bumps: standard treats breaking as 1.0.0 and features as 0.(minor+1).0; cautious downgrades breaking to minor and features to patch. Default standard.
